privacy: Your data stays on the center's server and is not shared with anyone.

login.title: Access your file
login.subtitle: Use your file number, phone number, and the code printed on your receipt.
login.fileNoHint: Printed on your receipt, for example PT-2026-000123
login.phoneHint: The number registered in your file
login.codeHint: The 8-digit code printed on your latest receipt
login.expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
login.help: No code? Ask reception, the cashier or the lab supervisor to print one for you.

guide.title: Where to find these
guide.file: File number: in the box “Patient portal access” at the bottom of your receipt or slip. It starts with PT.
guide.phone: Phone number: the number you gave at reception.
guide.code: Access code: the 8 digits under “Access code” in the same box. It works for 30 days.

home.title: Home
home.howToPay: Pay at the center's cashier, in cash or by bank transfer quoting your file number.
home.abnormalHint: Outside the normal range. Discuss it with your doctor.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: Your upcoming and past visits with the doctors.
appointments.cancelDescription: The time will be offered to other patients.
appointments.tooLate: It is too late to cancel online. Please call the center.
appointments.rules: You can hold up to {{max, bidi}} upcoming appointments and book up to {{days, bidi}} days ahead.
appointments.awaitingHint: Reception will confirm this request. If nobody answers by {{time}}, it lapses and the time is freed.
appointments.rescheduleUntil: You can change the time online until {{time}}.

book.title: Book an appointment
book.description: Choose a doctor, a day and a free time.
book.noDoctors: No doctor takes online bookings at the moment.
book.chooseDoctorFirst: Choose a doctor to see the free days.
book.noDays: This doctor has no free time in the coming days.
book.chooseDayFirst: Choose a day to see the free times.
book.noSlots: No free time left on this day.
book.requested: Your request was sent. Reception will confirm it.
book.rescheduleDescription: Your current appointment: {{date}} at {{time}}. Choose a new free time; the old one is released.

results.title: Lab results
results.description: Results appear here once the lab supervisor approves them.
results.noneHint: Results under work stay hidden until they are approved.
results.amendedNote: This result was corrected by the lab. It replaces the earlier version.
results.disclaimer: Discuss your results with your doctor.

prescriptions.title: Medicines and instructions
prescriptions.description: How to take what your doctor prescribed.
prescriptions.labHint: Preparation for tests that are still to be done.

bills.title: Bills and receipts
bills.description: Your share of each invoice and what you paid.

verify.title: Check a receipt
verify.description: Confirm that a receipt was issued by the center.
verify.receiptHint: Printed at the top of the receipt

statusHint.valid: This receipt matches the center's records.
statusHint.pending: The center recorded this transfer and is waiting for the bank to confirm it.
statusHint.void: This receipt is no longer valid. Please contact the center.

verify.notFound: This receipt could not be verified
verify.notFoundHint: Check the receipt number, or scan the QR code on the receipt again.
verify.rateLimited: Too many checks. Please try again in a few minutes.

code.title: Patient portal access
code.description: Print a code so the patient can see results and appointments on their phone.
code.howTo: Open {{url, bidi}} on your phone and sign in with your file number, your phone number and this code.
code.issued: A new portal code was issued. Earlier codes no longer work.

staff.title: Patient portal access
staff.none: No code is active. Print a slip so the patient can sign in to the portal.
staff.noPhone: Add a phone number to the file first: the patient signs in with it.
staff.revokeDescription: The code stops working at once and anyone signed in with it is signed out. Say why, for example a lost slip.
staff.slipDescription: Issue a code and print it for the patient. The code is shown only once.
staff.replaceWarning: This file already has an active code. A new code ends it and signs out anyone using it.

center.signInHint: You need your file number, your phone number and the code on your receipt.
center.endPrompt: See your results, appointments and bills.
center.unavailable: The center's details could not be loaded.

file.title: File number
file.text: Printed in the “Patient portal access” box at the bottom of your receipt. It starts with PT.

phone.title: Phone number
phone.text: The number you gave at reception.

code.title: Access code
code.text: The 8 digits in the same box. It works for 30 days.

center.insuranceHint: Bring your insurance card. Reception confirms your cover before the visit.

fees.title: Fees and appointments
fees.text: Fees are paid at reception. Prices are not shown online.

off.title: Online services are not available
off.body: This center does not offer its website or patient sign-in online at the moment. Please contact the center directly.

guest.title: Book online
guest.description: Choose a doctor, a day and a free time. You do not need a patient file.
guest.policyDefault: If you cannot come, cancel online before the time so another patient can have it.
guest.patientHint: Already a patient with a file?
guest.patientSignIn: Sign in to book from your file

resume.title: Your last request
resume.text: We did not get an answer for the booking you sent. Send it again to see what happened: it will never be booked twice.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: The name of the person who will come.
form.phoneHint: Reception may call or message this number, for example 0912 345 678.
form.nameRequired: Enter the name of the person who will come.

guest.reviewHint: Your phone number is not checked online; reception confirms who you are when you arrive.
guest.retryHint: The connection was interrupted. Try again: the same request is sent and you will not be booked twice.

done.requestedText: Reception will confirm your request. Keep your reference and PIN to follow it.
done.bookedText: Your appointment is confirmed. Keep your reference and PIN to view, change or cancel it.
done.saveText: The PIN is shown only this once. You need the reference and the PIN to open, change or cancel your booking. Write them down, take a screenshot or print this page.
done.pinMissing: The PIN was replaced by reception. Ask reception for it.
done.shareHint: The WhatsApp message carries the reference only, never the PIN.

signIn.title: Open your booking
signIn.subtitle: Use the booking reference and the 6-digit PIN you got when you booked.
signIn.ended: Your session ended. Enter your reference and PIN again.
signIn.lockedHint: Check both and try again. After several wrong PINs the booking is locked: call or visit reception for a new PIN.
signIn.referenceHint: 10 letters and digits, for example ABCDE-FGH23
signIn.pinHint: The 6 digits shown when you booked
signIn.help: Lost your PIN? Reception can give you a new one after checking who you are.
signIn.referenceInvalid: Enter the 10-character reference, for example ABCDE-FGH23

view.title: Your booking
view.unavailable: Your booking cannot be shown now. Try again later or call the center.
view.noActions: This booking can no longer be changed online. Please call the center.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: What changed in your bookings and results, newest first.
notices.noneHint: When the center answers a booking or a result is ready, you will see it here.
notices.awaitingHint: The new time waits for reception to confirm it.

body.booking_requested: Your request for {{time}} with {{doctor}} is waiting for reception to confirm it.
body.booking_confirmed: Your appointment on {{time}} with {{doctor}} is confirmed.
body.booking_declined: The center declined your request for {{time}} with {{doctor}}.
body.booking_cancelled: The center cancelled your appointment on {{time}} with {{doctor}}.
body.booking_cancelled_by_you: You cancelled your appointment on {{time}} with {{doctor}}.
body.booking_expired: Your request for {{time}} with {{doctor}} expired before the center answered. You can book again.

timeline.title: Visit {{number, bidi}}
timeline.noInvoices: No invoice yet. Fees are paid at reception.
